newsitem.title: USA: Brazil's Malan confident CVRD will be privatized.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Malan confident CVRD will be privatized.

text.p: Brazilian Finance Minister Pedro Malan said on Tuesday he was confident that Brazil will be able to privatise the giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) mining company.
The auction of Latin America's largest mining company due to take place earlier on Tuesday was hampered by court injunctions.
Malan said the delay was due to a flurry of lawsuits filed in Brazilian courts to try to halt the sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares on Rio de Janeiro's stock exchange.
"But we are confident that it will be privatised, sooner or later," he told reporters at a news conference on the fringes of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank spring meeting.
Asked when the sale might actually go ahead, the minister replied: "I do not have a crystal ball."
Brazil could raise about $5 billion if it manages to privatise all of CVRD, the world's largest iron ore exporter.
The Brazilian government has deployed a battalion of lawyers to fly to cities and towns to fight injunctions against the privatisation.
The privatisation is a test of confidence in the Brazilian economy for foreign investors.
